name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # --------------------------------------------------
      # Setup languages
      # --------------------------------------------------
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      # --------------------------------------------------
      # Install dependencies
      # --------------------------------------------------
      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Install Tavern frontend dependencies
        run: |
          cd tavern-frontend
          npm ci

      # --------------------------------------------------
      # Build artifacts
      # --------------------------------------------------
      - name: Build Tavern frontend
        run: |
          cd tavern-frontend
          npm run build

      - name: Build Tavern server
        run: |
          cd tavern-server
          cargo build --release

      - name: Build Imixv2 agent
        run: |
          cd imixv2
          go build -o imixv2

      # --------------------------------------------------
      # Start services
      # --------------------------------------------------
      - name: Start Tavern server
        run: |
          cd tavern-server
          ./target/release/tavern-server --port 8080 &
          echo $! > $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tavern_server_pid.txt
        env:
          RUST_LOG: info

      - name: Wait for Tavern server to be ready
        run: |
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:8080/health; then
              echo "Tavern server is up"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Retrieve Tavern server public key
        id: get_key
        run: |
          KEY=$(curl -s http://localhost:8080/public-key)
          echo "public_key=$KEY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Start Imixv2 agent
        run: |
          cd imixv2
          ./imixv2 --server-key "${{ steps.get_key.outputs.public_key }}" &
          echo $! > $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/imixv2_pid.txt

      # --------------------------------------------------
      # Run Playwright tests
      # --------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run Playwright E2E tests
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npx playwright test
        env:
          SERVER_URL: http://localhost:8080
          IMIXV2_KEY: ${{ steps.get_key.outputs.public_key }}

      # --------------------------------------------------
      # Cleanup
      # --------------------------------------------------
      - name: Cleanup background processes
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tavern_server_pid.txt ]; then
            kill $(cat $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tavern_server_pid.txt) || true
          fi
          if [ -f $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/imixv2_pid.txt ]; then
            kill $(cat $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/imixv2_pid.txt) || true
          fi
